This game is an absolute joy. I hella enjoyed the experience I had with friends I played with. I cried by the end of it.

What to say - on the one hand I really loved the game's core, on the other hand it was just so incredibly short that I was sitting there thinking, "Wait... this was it??"

If you decide to play this game, you can easily do it in one session (as I did). For that amount of time I feel the game is overpriced and I would strongly advise to wait for a sale.

Because of this feeling of disappointment after finishing the game, I reluctantly have to not recommend the game - at least not for full price.

An incredibly enjoyable game featuring a striking black and white aesthetic that truly immerses the player in it's world. The storyline is captivating and the underlying message is clear. Each character holds a distinct significance. The wolves are the ruthless rulling class. The pigs represent the factory workers and low level security guards who submit to the wolves orders and the ravengirl embody an oppressed minority. It is a fascinating concept that mirrors the reality of todays world. congratulations to the developers. Highly recomended game.

I really dig the vibes, aesthetics, and sound design, but the gameplay itself is just... annoying? The enemy design feels like it's trying to evoke an oppressive atmosphere more than be fun.
Trial and error retries took a significant part of my 1h playtime, and it did not result in a feeling of skill/power, or immersion in the world or that oppressive atmosphere. Just glad a section of the game was over when I finally beat it.

All this works up to the ending, which I don't think is very good. It tries to give some food for thought, but feels like a cop-out to me.

So while I wouldn't recommend it, if it still sounds interesting, go for it. It's cheap as hell and there is a passion behind it.

Besides the fact this game has no one playing it. My friend and I bought the game. We had a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ blast. The bots do try to murder you if they are the killer. They do collect resources and hoard them sometimes. This game is fun to play with friends. A dead game is only dead until people revive it. Does it need some optimization? Yeah, a bit, there is a delay in when the game announces someone dies. A mic bug that's solved by leaving the lobby and coming back. Those are my biggest issues. However, I love the look of it cause it's like those old PS2 games honestly. I've seen worse graphics. This game is fun and we bought it on a sale. Major props to the Dev who kept putting out content and bug fixes when the game slowed down. Even put out a Halloween event. I hope it comes out this year too, cause I would like to play it with my friends.

Unfortunately the newest entry in what used to be an incredible franchise falls flat yet again. Forced stealth section after stealth section and I doubt I'm even a quarter of the way through the game. Combat has never been a SH strong point but this is simply awful, combined with extremely bland enemy design. The stealth sections wouldn't even be so bad if the stealth wasn't ridiculously annoying. I got to the knock off Toluca prison and think I've had enough. Glad I didn't pay full price for this. Credit to the devs for the design on St. Amelia though, I grew up in a small Scottish village and they got the design spot on.

Super cool remaster and really enjoyed playing it through, however I can't give a game a thumbs up to a game that makes it impossible to obtain 3 of the achievements. I attempted using console commands, but nope: 2K decided to remove the ability to do that when switching launchers I guess. Unfortunately I found this all out the hard way, but if you really want to complete this game to 100%, you're better off playing this on console where the achievements are obtainable (to my knowledge). Again, I'd love to give this a proper good review, but I won't do so unless 2K decides to make a patch to 100% complete the game.
